1.h4 e5 2.d4.strategy: Strikes at e5 straight away to open the centre. Black can simply take the pawn, so White must back the idea with further sacrifice or quick development, and the early h-pawn move leaves White a little behind in the race.

1.h4 e5 2.d4 exd4.strategy: Takes the pawn and removes White's central pawn, leaving Black a pawn up with the more natural development. The extra pawn is worth keeping, but White gets time to build lines, so Black has to go on developing with care.
